scope: Individual-call warm/cold CUDA Graph GPU latency for complete public routed MoE. Excludes cache eviction, input quantization, routing selection, shared experts, communication, attention, and host submission. Not serving/model throughput.
kernel_note: MX device kernels match common-cache-policy commit 4ef610c13; the subsequent BF16 address fix does not change these MX tactics; production tuning changes postdate this matrix. Every reported tactic was independently retuned and pinned by the latency benchmark.
method: Six changing-input graph checks plus post-timing reference checks; independent normal/reverse processes; 16 event-delimited calls per graph; two sweeps of nine timed replays per backend. Show only selected pairs passing repeat, cross-process, native A/A, and same-tactic controls within 1%. A stable selected pair does not imply all other candidate timings were stable.
cold_cache: Read/write sweep of at least 512 MiB and twice queried L2 before every measured call, outside events.
numerics: Same canonical quantized weights, activation and routing inputs. Packed Frost/TRT narrows routing weights to BF16; native CuTe keeps FP32. Relative L2 < 1%, normalized max < 3%; not bitwise identity.
